浮层

文字提示 AsamTooltip

为控件提供短说明，不承载必须完成的业务操作。

使用场景 ​

为控件提供短说明，不承载必须完成的业务操作。

焦点与悬停提示 ​

按钮获得焦点或鼠标悬停时显示提示；复杂说明通过 content 插槽。

焦点与悬停提示

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTooltip placement="top" :trigger="['hover', 'focus']" :show-after="100">
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button">查看提示</AsamButton>
		<template #content>
			草稿保存在当前设备。
			<br />
			按完成提交。
		</template>
	</AsamTooltip>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTooltipBasicDemo' });
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';
</script>
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP

受控提示 ​

两个按钮均由宿主切换 visible 状态。示例将 trigger 与 triggerKeys 设为空数组，避免宿主切换与默认自动触发同时执行。

受控提示

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<div class="actions">
		<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="visible = !visible">
			切换提示
		</AsamButton>
		<AsamTooltip
			v-model:visible="visible"
			content="由宿主控制显隐"
			:trigger="[]"
			:trigger-keys="[]"
		>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="visible = !visible">
				提示锚点
			</AsamButton>
		</AsamTooltip>
	</div>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamTooltipControlledDemo' });
import { ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const visible = ref(false);
</script>

<style scoped>
.actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	align-items: center;
}

.panel {
	padding: var(--asam-space-lg);
	border: 1px solid var(--asam-color-border);
	border-radius: var(--asam-radius-control);
}
</style>

使用约定 ​

content 属性或 content 插槽提供提示；trigger、placement、showAfter/hideAfter、disabled、visible、virtualRef 和浮层定位参数决定交互。 完整说明。

完整用法 ​

以下用法使用本库公开入口。每个示例提供完整 TS/JS SFC，参数、事件、插槽和实例类型见本页 API。服务实例由创建方负责关闭；HTML 内容仅用于调用方已知的可信字符串。

基本用法 ​

<template>
	<div
		class="placement-scroll"

虚拟触发目标 ​

虚拟触发目标

展开源码
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTooltip
		:visible="visible"
		content="底部居中"
		placement="bottom"
		effect="light"
		trigger="click"
		virtual-triggering
		:virtual-ref="triggerRef"
	/>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="visible = !visible">切换文字提示</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';

const visible = ref(false);
const position = ref(DOMRect.fromRect({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }));

const triggerRef = ref({
	getBoundingClientRect: () => position.value
});

const mousemoveHandler = ({ clientX, clientY }: MouseEvent) => {
	position.value = DOMRect.fromRect({
		x: clientX,
		y: clientY
	});
};

onMounted(() => {
	document.addEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
	document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});
</script>
许可场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<AsamTooltip
		:visible="visible"
		content="底部居中"
		placement="bottom"
		effect="light"
		trigger="click"
		virtual-triggering
		:virtual-ref="triggerRef"
	/>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="visible = !visible">切换文字提示</AsamButton>
</template>

<script setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';
const visible = ref(false);
const position = ref(DOMRect.fromRect({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }));
const triggerRef = ref({
	getBoundingClientRect: () => position.value
});
const mousemoveHandler = ({ clientX, clientY }) => {
	position.value = DOMRect.fromRect({
		x: clientX,
		y: clientY
	});
};
onMounted(() => {
	document.addEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});
onUnmounted(() => {
	document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});
</script>

<template>
	<AsamTooltip
		:visible="visible"
		content="底部居中"
		placement="bottom"
		effect="light"
		trigger="click"
		virtual-triggering
		:virtual-ref="triggerRef"
	/>
	<AsamButton type="primary" @click="visible = !visible">切换文字提示</AsamButton>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { AsamButton, AsamTooltip } from '@asam-ui/ui';

import { onMounted, onUnmounted, ref } from 'vue';

const visible = ref(false);
const position = ref(DOMRect.fromRect({ x: 0, y: 0, width: 0, height: 0 }));

const triggerRef = ref({
	getBoundingClientRect: () => position.value
});

const mousemoveHandler = ({ clientX, clientY }: MouseEvent) => {
	position.value = DOMRect.fromRect({
		x: clientX,
		y: clientY
	});
};

onMounted(() => {
	document.addEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});

onUnmounted(() => {
	document.removeEventListener('mousemove', mousemoveHandler);
});
</script>

# AsamTooltip 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;
removing the four derived implementations does not remove their notices.
VueUse shared and metadata 15.0.0 carry the same license text as core. The
following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper
inputs; the installed Element Plus components and Vue remain peer dependencies.

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

使用约定 ​

content 属性或 content 插槽提供提示；trigger、placement、showAfter/hideAfter、disabled、visible、virtualRef 和浮层定位参数决定交互。visible 绑定用于受控模式，省略时由 trigger 管理。公开 hide、onOpen/onClose、updatePopper 可管理提示，复杂交互使用 Popover。默认插槽需提供一个可聚焦触发元素。本入口没有四档控件 size。

组合职责与生命周期 ​

default 提供触发内容，content 或 content 插槽提供提示。visible 提供受控状态，trigger/triggerKeys、showAfter/hideAfter/autoClose、disabled 与 enterable 控制交互。virtualTriggering 配合 HTMLElement 或 getBoundingClientRect 目标；共享 singleton 面板切换 virtualRef 时更新定位，外部鼠标监听必须在卸载移除。appendTo/teleported/persistent 管理挂载和存活，effect/rawContent/transition/popperStyle/popperClass 管理呈现；HTML 只承接已知可信内容。公开 popperRef/contentRef/isFocusInsideContent、updatePopper、onOpen/onClose/hide 保留实时状态。

气泡面板 AsamPopover浮层定位容器 AsamPopper

import type { AsamTooltipProps } from '@asam-ui/ui';

type PublicMember<T, K extends PropertyKey> = T extends unknown ? K extends keyof T ? T[K] : never : never;

// AsamTooltipProps
type PublicContract = {
	"showArrow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"onUpdate:visible"?: ((value: boolean) => void) | undefined;
	"role"?: "group" | "dialog" | "grid" | "listbox" | "menu" | "navigation" | "tooltip" | "tree" | undefined;
	"appendTo"?: string | HTMLElement | undefined;
	"content"?: string | undefined;
	"rawContent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"persistent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"visible"?: boolean | null | undefined;
	"transition"?: string | undefined;
	"teleported"?: boolean | undefined;
	"disabled"?: boolean | undefined;
	"ariaLabel"?: string | undefined;
	"showAfter"?: number | undefined;
	"hideAfter"?: number | undefined;
	"autoClose"?: number | undefined;
	"gpuAcceleration"?: boolean | undefined;
	"id"?: string | undefined;
	"style"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["style"];
	"className"?: AsamTooltipProps["className"];
	"effect"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["effect"];
	"enterable"?: boolean | undefined;
	"pure"?: boolean | undefined;
	"focusOnShow"?: boolean | undefined;
	"trapping"?: boolean | undefined;
	"popperClass"?: AsamTooltipProps["className"];
	"popperStyle"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["popperStyle"];
	"referenceEl"?: HTMLElement | undefined;
	"triggerTargetEl"?: HTMLElement | undefined;
	"stopPopperMouseEvent"?: boolean | undefined;
	"virtualTriggering"?: boolean | undefined;
	"zIndex"?: number | undefined;
	"loop"?: boolean | undefined;
	"boundariesPadding"?: number | undefined;
	"fallbackPlacements"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["fallbackPlacements"];
	"offset"?: number | undefined;
	"placement"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["placement"];
	"popperOptions"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["popperOptions"];
	"strategy"?: "fixed" | "absolute" | undefined;
	"arrowOffset"?: number | undefined;
	"trigger"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["trigger"];
	"triggerKeys"?: string[] | undefined;
	"focusOnTarget"?: boolean | undefined;
	"virtualRef"?: (AsamTooltipProps)["virtualRef"];
	"onMouseenter"?: ((e: MouseEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onMouseleave"?: ((e: MouseEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onClick"?: ((e: PointerEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onKeydown"?: ((e: KeyboardEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onFocus"?: ((e: FocusEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onBlur"?: ((e: FocusEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"onContextmenu"?: ((e: PointerEvent) => void) | undefined;
	"open"?: boolean | undefined;
};
